# HrvaDrive

> HrvaDrive turns an OBD2 drive log exported from the Car Scanner ELM OBD2 app into a drive report. It is free, needs no account, and keeps your drive history in your browser only.

Upload a Car Scanner drive export (vertical or horizontal CSV, optionally with a .brc vehicle file) and get a report with distance, time, fuel and cost, economy, a route map with hard-brake, idle and coasting events, an eco-driving score with tips, a driving profile, gear usage and engine health insights (RPM, boost, coolant, battery). Reports can be saved as PDF, and two drives can be compared. The analysis server is stateless: the log is processed in memory and not stored. Drive history is saved in the browser (IndexedDB) and never leaves the device. The map loads tiles from OpenStreetMap. HrvaDrive is a hobby project provided as is, with no warranty, and is not affiliated with Car Scanner.

- Name: HrvaDrive, a HrvaLabs project (https://hrvalabs.net/)
- Author: Karlo Hrvačić (https://karlo.cc)
- Licence: MIT
